grain_notes.open_tickets: Python counts.open_tickets is parsed-row grain (DimTicket rows with is_open=1), not DISTINCTCOUNT of ticket_id. Duplicate ticket_id values are two DimTicket rows.
grain_notes.breached_slas: Python counts.breached_slas is finding-grain. A ticket with both a response and a resolve breach (TCK-1021) counts twice as findings and once as a distinct ticket.
grain_notes.attention: Python counts.attention is one row per attention evidence_id. Duplicate ticket_id TCK-1020 has two attention rows.
